items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N),
  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description: Let $M$ and $N$ be additive commutative monoids, where $N$ is equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any subadditive function $f : M \to N$ satisfying $f(0) \leq 0$, and for any finite set $s$ of indices and function $g : s \to M$, it holds that $f\left(\sum_{i \in s} g(i)\right) \leq \sum_{i \in s} f(g(i))$.

items.informal_name: Subadditive Function Inequality on Finite Sets
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {M : Type u_4} {N : Type u_5} [inst : AddCommMonoid M] [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid N]
  [inst_2 : PartialOrder N] [IsOrderedAddMonoid N] (f : M → N) (p : M → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → f (x + y) ≤ f x + f y) →
      (∀ (x y : M), p x → p y → p (x + y)) →
        ∀ (g : ι → M) {s : Finset ι}, (∀ i ∈ s, p (g i)) → f (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, f (g i)
items.informal_description:
Let $ M $ and $ N $ be additive commutative monoids with $ N $ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any function $ f : M → N $ satisfying $ f(0) ≤ 0 $, and predicate $ p : M → 	ext{Prop} $ such that:
1. $ f $ is subadditive on $ p $-elements: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ f(x + y) ≤ f(x) + f(y) $,
2. $ p $-elements are closed under addition: $ p(x) ∧ p(y) ⇒ p(x + y) $,
then for any finite set $ s $ and function $ g : ι → M $ with $ p(g(i)) $ for all $ i ∈ s $, we have:
$$
 f\left(\sum_{i ∈ s} g(i)\right) ≤ \sum_{i ∈ s} f(g(i)).
$$

items.informal_description: Let $ \alpha $ be an additive monoid and $ \beta $ an ordered commutative additive monoid. For any function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ satisfying $ f(0) \leq 0 $ and subadditivity $ f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b) $ for all $ a, b \in \alpha $, it holds that $ f(\sum_{x \in l} x) \leq \sum_{x \in l} f(x) $ for any finite list $ l $ of elements in $ \alpha $.

  [IsOrderedAddMonoid β] (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop),
  f 0 ≤ 0 →
    p 0 →
      (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) →
        (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → p (a + b)) → ∀ (l : List α), (∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → p a) → f l.sum ≤ (List.map f l).sum
items.informal_description: Let $ \alpha $ be an additive monoid and $ \beta $ an ordered additive commutative monoid. For a function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and predicate $ p : \alpha \to \mathrm{Prop} $, if $ f(0) \leq 0 $, $ p(0) $ holds, $ f $ is subadditive on $ p $-elements (i.e., $ f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b) $ whenever $ p(a) $ and $ p(b) $), and $ p $ is closed under addition, then for any list $ l $ of $ \alpha $-elements satisfying $ p $, it holds that $ f(\sum l) \leq \sum_{x \in l} f(x) $.

  f 0 ≤ 0 → (∀ (a b : α), f (a + b) ≤ f a + f b) → ∀ (s : Multiset α), f s.sum ≤ (Multiset.map f s).sum
items.informal_description: Let $\alpha$ and $\beta$ be additive commutative monoids, with $\beta$ equipped with a partial order compatible with addition. For any function $f : \alpha \to \beta$ satisfying $f(0) \leq 0$ and subadditivity $f(a + b) \leq f(a) + f(b)$ for all $a, b \in \alpha$, it holds that $f(\sum s) \leq \sum_{x \in s} f(x)$ for every multiset $s$ over $\alpha$. items.informal_name: Mahler Measure Upper Bound by Coefficient Norms
items.type: ∀ (p : Polynomial ℂ), p.mahlerMeasure ≤ p.sum fun x a => ‖a‖
items.informal_description: For any complex polynomial $ p $, its Mahler measure satisfies $ \text{Mahler}(p) \leq \sum_{n} \|a_n\| $, where $ a_n $ are the coefficients of $ p $ and $ \|\cdot\| $ denotes the complex norm.

items.informal_name: Finiteness of Integer Polynomials with Bounded Degree and Mahler Measure
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal), {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.Finite
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and non-negative real number $B$, the set of integer polynomials $p$ with natural degree $\leq n$ and Mahler measure $\leq B$ is finite. Formally, the set $\{p \in \mathbb{Z}[X] \mid \deg(p) \leq n \text{ and } \mathcal{M}(p) \leq B\}$ has finitely many elements, where $\mathcal{M}(p)$ denotes the Mahler measure of $p$.

items.informal_name: Gauss norm of a polynomial
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → {F : Type u_2} → [inst : Semiring R] → [FunLike F R ℝ] → F → ℝ → Polynomial R → ℝ
items.informal_description: The Gauss norm of a polynomial $ p $ is defined as the supremum of $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ over all exponents $ i $ in the support of $ p $, where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $. If $ p $ is the zero polynomial (with empty support), the Gauss norm is defined to be $ 0 $. Here, $ v $ denotes a valuation and $ c $ is a real number parameter.

items.informal_name: Cauchy bound for polynomial roots
items.type: {K : Type u_1} → [inst : NormedDivisionRing K] → Polynomial K → NNReal
items.informal_description: The Cauchy bound of a polynomial $ p $ over a normed division ring $ K $ is defined as $ 1 + \frac{\sup_{0 \leq i < \deg p} \|\text{coeff}_i(p)\|}{\|\text{leadingCoeff}(p)\|} $, where $ \sup $ denotes the supremum of the absolute values of the coefficients excluding the leading term, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the norm on $ K $. This provides an upper bound on the absolute values of the roots of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Coefficient Bound via Binomial Coefficient and Mahler Measure
items.type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : Polynomial ℂ), ‖p.coeff n‖ ≤ ↑(p.natDegree.choose n) * p.mahlerMeasure
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and complex polynomial $ p $, the norm of the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $ satisfies $ \|p.coeff\,n\| \leq \binom{d}{n} \cdot p.mahlerMeasure $, where $ d $ denotes the natural degree of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Cardinality Bound for Integer Polynomials with Bounded Mahler Measure and Degree
items.type:
∀ (n : ℕ) (B : NNReal),
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℂ) p).mahlerMeasure ≤ ↑B}.ncard ≤
    ∏ i, (2 * ⌊↑(n.choose ↑i) * B⌋₊ + 1)
items.informal_description: For any natural number $ n $ and non-negative real number $ B $, the number of integer polynomials $ p $ with natural degree at most $ n $ and Mahler measure $ \mathcal{M}(p) \leq B $ is at most the product over $ i = 0 $ to $ n $ of $ 2 \left\lfloor \binom{n}{i} B \right\rfloor + 1 $.

items.informal_name: Spectral value terms sequence
items.type: {R : Type u_1} → [inst : SeminormedRing R] → Polynomial R → ℕ → ℝ
items.informal_description: For a polynomial $ p $ over a seminormed ring $ R $, this function returns a sequence indexed by $ \mathbb{N} $ where each term is defined as $ \|p_n\|^{1/(d - n)} $ if $ n < d $, and $ 0 $ otherwise. Here, $ p_n $ denotes the coefficient of $ X^n $ in $ p $, $ d $ is the natural degree of $ p $, and $ \|\cdot\| $ is the seminorm on $ R $. This sequence captures the normed coefficients' growth rates relative to their distance from the polynomial's degree.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm Upper Bound for Coefficient Terms
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) {c : ℝ} (p : Polynomial R)
  [ZeroHomClass F R ℝ] [NonnegHomClass F R ℝ], 0 ≤ c → ∀ (i : ℕ), v (p.coeff i) * c ^ i ≤ Polynomial.gaussNorm v c p
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $ over a semiring $ R $, valuation $ v $ (preserving zero and non-negative), non-negative real number $ c $, and natural number $ i $, the product $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i $ (where $ a_i $ is the coefficient of $ X^i $ in $ p $) satisfies $ v(a_i) \cdot c^i \leq \|p\|_{v,c} $, where $ \|p\|_{v,c} $ denotes the Gauss norm of $ p $ with respect to $ v $ and $ c $.

items.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Abelian Groups
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {E : Type u_9} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup E] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → E),
  ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖
items.informal_description: For any seminormed additive commutative group $E$, finite set $s$ of indices, and function $f : s \to E$, the norm of the sum of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$ is less than or equal to the sum of the norms of $f(i)$ over $i \in s$. Mathematically, this is expressed as $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\| \leq \sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|$.

items.informal_name: Triangle Inequality for Finite Sums in Seminormed Additive Commutative Groups

items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $ and any function $ f : \iota \to E $ in a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, the non-negative norm of the sum $ \sum_{a \in s} f(a) $ is less than or equal to the sum of the non-negative norms of $ f(a) $, i.e., $ \left\| \sum_{a \in s} f(a) \right\|_+ \leq \sum_{a \in s} \| f(a) \|_+ $.

items.informal_name: Norm of Sum Bounded by Sum of Bounds in Seminormed Group
items.type:

items.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ of type $ \iota $, functions $ f : \iota \to E $ and $ n : \iota \to \mathbb{R} $, and a seminormed additive commutative group $ E $, if $ \|f(b)\| \leq n(b) $ for all $ b \in s $, then $ \left\| \sum_{b \in s} f(b) \right\| \leq \sum_{b \in s} n(b) $.

items.informal_description: In a seminormed additive commutative monoid $\varepsilon$, for any finite set $s \subseteq \iota$ and function $f : \iota \to \varepsilon$, the extended norm of the sum $\left\| \sum_{i \in s} f(i) \right\|_e$ is less than or equal to the sum of the extended norms $\sum_{i \in s} \|f(i)\|_e$.

items.informal_name: Extended Norm of Sum is Bounded by Sum of Extended Norms
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_3} {ε : Type u_8} [inst : TopologicalSpace ε] [inst_1 : ESeminormedAddCommMonoid ε] (s : Finset ι)
